packages.notes: Declutter: Developer and Satisfaction Counter moved out of the everyday app grid into one entry point under Settings > Updates > Beta features, per direct feedback.
Multi-display: desktop now spans every monitor, window snap and hot corners are monitor-aware. Files: places refresh live on drive plug/unplug, and removable volumes get a real Eject action.

A one-time bridge for devices old enough that their own update checker refuses newer updates outright (the update contains a file it may not change). Kept permanently on the feed, not just as a temporary latest, so this cannot recur for a device that missed the original window: install this first, then check again for anything newer.
The desktop's Music widget is real now (was Coming soon): title/artist and Previous/Play-Pause/Next through playerctl. Needs a full ISO rebuild to actually control anything.
